# Copilot Instructions

- Always read `AGENTS.md` first.
- Also read these docs when relevant:
  - `docs/business-analysis.txt`
  - `docs/documentation.txt`
  - `docs/sprints.txt`
  - `docs/ui-reference.md`
- Treat `AGENTS.md` as the frontend engineering source of truth.
- This is React frontend only.
- Do not add Angular code.
- Keep UI Arabic-first, RTL-first, and mobile-first.
- After every code change, review whether `AGENTS.md` needs an update.
